T-IN-7: 2.5 times the bytes to fetch above the free space is refused
T-IN-8: three members of one archive from one download, each verified
T-IN-9: an optional role that cannot be fetched is recorded, a required one refused
the record phase hashes inputs and members; two equal records compare equal
T-ANN-1: an incomplete or empty UniProt answer refuses the record
T-PRE-1: phase pre admits listed aggregates only and refuses truth reads
T-LIC-1 to T-LIC-4: unlisted file, extra column, per-feature class, too many rows
T-LIC-5 to T-LIC-8: copies, archives and the size of scored.tsv.gz
T-LIC-9: declared outputs, keyed lineage, and path placeholders
T-LIC-10: the lifecycle keeps scored.tsv.gz and primary call counts private
T-LIC-11: result tables of a not-permitted input, label keys, attribution

T-R1-2: uniprot.tsv is on the allow-list with its columns; an extra column is refused
